data.rationale: The proposal has the right goal and step order (Airport tab, pick airport, set dates, sort) with matching parameters, but it adds an unobserved "Click Search" step, never says to type the airport name, doesn't say how to pick dates in the calendar grid, and leaves the sort option vague (it names the default "Featured" and not the target value), so an automation would need guesswork.
